title: RAW UNREVIEWED: one word base in plain, l-prefixed and qo-prefixed grammatical forms
summary: Simple working picture: keep an unknown base and let a small prefix change its use, rather than its whole content. Literal kedy/lkedy/qokedy and sheckhy/lsheckhy motivate an anonymous role sketch. No English prefix/root meanings, lemma identity or grammar have been established; this is a constructive whole-passage direction, not a selected decoder.

design.mechanism: Reuse a base X through plain X, L(X) and QO(X). Propose different grammatical roles with shared unknown content; no fixed article, verb, case or conjunction translation.
design.unit: Exact raw word families and complete exposed passage; preserve all original groups, repeated words and alternate readings.
design.contrast: Shared word formation and grammatical role versus independent lexical wholes, writing variants or different stem boundaries.
design.prediction: Before selection, author a single explicit role construction in the complete77group passage, retain all unknown contributions and expose every conflict. The same root and prefix must retain their defined role at each licensed occurrence; no casewise casts or defaultClass-for-allwords. This raw sketch itself has no executed or fixed general grammar test.
design.scope: Exploratory anonymous morphology/syntax, not meanings, phonetics, language selection or a global qo/l parser.

Do not turn QO into a particular English function or require a whole-source-word boundary without evidence.
